title: magma
description: A set equipped with a single binary operation, with no axioms on the operation — the most general algebraic structure with one operation. The generated object of `combining` a carrier set under a binary operation; the root of the algebraic descent.

carrier.description: the underlying set the operation acts on

operation.description: a single binary operation ∗ : M × M → M (total/closed by typing)

axioms.description: no axioms are imposed at the magma level
